# Molekule

> Molekule manufactures FDA-cleared air purifiers and humidifiers using proprietary PECO nanotechnology combined with HEPA filtration for advanced indoor air quality management.

Molekule offers a comprehensive ecosystem of smart air purification devices designed to destroy allergens, mold spores, viruses, and other airborne pollutants. The company provides educational resources on air quality health impacts, product technology, and subscription-based filter services alongside a loyalty rewards program.
